description: Hero's Seaside Sanctuary — reference reconstruction v0012. Rebuilt from the approved 128-piece environment pack: open rear arch to ocean, royal bed left on its rug, dining table right on its rug, centred compass emblem, front staircase, four-level assembly (background/ground/walls-decorations/shadows). Visual approval pending.

ocean.notes: Horizon lowered to reference, original water sprites retained. No giant pasted cliff sprites.

asset_quality_review.description: Atlas debris cleanup completed for selected sprites; detailed reference-style art is still in progress.

floor_art.design: central compass emblem as D03 ground overlay at grid cell (6,4)

change_note: hero_room_01 reference reconstruction v0012: replace v0011 layout with deterministic reference-reconstruction blueprint using the approved 128-piece environment pack; PNG bytes unchanged.

visual_qa.notes: Native Godot render v0012; compare against reference and v0011.

navigation.note: Navigation provisional, unreviewed; no character or weapon factory changes.

floor_footprint.notes: Row 0 leaves cells 5-10 open so the rear arch opening reveals the ocean behind it.

footprint.notes: Row 0 leaves cells 5-10 open so the rear arch opening reveals the ocean behind it.

layer_stack.note: Shadows are last DATA pass, rendered z20 below walls z30 and props z40.
